title: ULMS - 添加内容组件
question: 如何在课件中添加内容组件？
questionEn: How do I add content components to courseware?
aliases: 如何在课件中添加内容组件？
How do I add content components to courseware?
path: 2026 教师用户手册 > ULMS > 添加内容组件

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: 在课件编辑区点击【视频】组件，打开视频添加窗口。
steps.textEn: In the courseware editing area, click the Video component to open the video addition window.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step1.png

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: 选择从课件资源、个人资源库引用视频，或从电脑本地上传视频。
steps.textEn: Choose to reference a video from courseware resources or your personal resource library, or upload a video from your computer.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step2.png

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: 选中已插入的视频，按需添加注释、在线剪辑或替换视频。
steps.textEn: Select the inserted video and add notes, edit it online, or replace it as needed.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step3.png

steps.label: Step 4
steps.text: 在课件编辑区点击【音频】组件，打开音频添加窗口。
steps.textEn: In the courseware editing area, click the Audio component to open the audio addition window.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step4.png

steps.label: Step 5
steps.text: 选择已有音频资源，或点击本地上传并等待文件处理完成。
steps.textEn: Select an existing audio resource, or click to upload locally and wait for the file to finish processing.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step5.png

steps.label: Step 6
steps.text: 选中音频组件，设置播放方式并检查音频是否可以正常播放。
steps.textEn: Select the audio component, set the playback mode, and check that the audio plays correctly.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step6.png

steps.label: Step 7
steps.text: 在课件编辑区点击【文档】组件，打开文档添加窗口。
steps.textEn: In the courseware editing area, click the Document component to open the document addition window.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step7.png

steps.label: Step 8
steps.text: 选择已有文档或上传本地文件，确认后将文档插入当前页面。
steps.textEn: Select an existing document or upload a local file, then confirm to insert the document into the current page.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step8.png

steps.label: Step 9
steps.text: 点击【练习】组件，从课件试题中选择需要插入的题目。
steps.textEn: Click the Practice component and choose the questions to insert from the courseware questions.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step9.png

steps.label: Step 10
steps.text: 需要新题时点击【添加新题】，选择题型并完整填写题干和答案。
steps.textEn: If you need new questions, click Add New Question, select the question type, and fully fill in the prompt and answer.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step10.png

steps.label: Step 11
steps.text: 设置练习题的作答、答案显示和反馈方式，然后保存练习。
steps.textEn: Set how the practice questions are answered, how answers are displayed, and the feedback method, then save the practice.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step11.png

steps.label: Step 12
steps.text: 点击【音频文字】组件，进入音频与文本同步编辑页面。
steps.textEn: Click the Audio Text component to enter the audio and text synchronization editing page.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step12.png

steps.label: Step 13
steps.text: 上传或选择音频，并录入与音频对应的文本内容。
steps.textEn: Upload or select audio, and enter the text content that matches the audio.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step13.png

steps.label: Step 14
steps.text: 调整文本与音频的对应关系，试听无误后保存组件。
steps.textEn: Adjust the alignment between the text and audio, preview to confirm it is correct, then save the component.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step14.png

steps.label: Step 15
steps.text: 点击【口语评分】组件，进入口语练习设置页面。
steps.textEn: Click the Speaking Scoring component to enter the speaking practice settings page.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step15.png

steps.label: Step 16
steps.text: 阅读使用说明，准备朗读文本和评分所需的音频设置。
steps.textEn: Read the usage instructions and prepare the reading text and audio settings needed for scoring.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step16.png

steps.label: Step 17
steps.text: 填写朗读内容与评分参数，保存后预览口语评分组件。
steps.textEn: Fill in the reading content and scoring parameters, save, then preview the speaking scoring component.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/添加内容组件/step17.png

title: ULMS - 课件发布与更新
question: 如何发布或更新课件？
questionEn: How do I publish or update courseware?
aliases: How do I publish or update courseware?
path: 2026 教师用户手册 > ULMS > 课件发布与更新

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: 完成课件内容、基本信息和门户信息后，返回课件首页点击【发布】。
steps.textEn: After completing the courseware content, basic information, and portal information, return to the courseware homepage and click Publish.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/课件发布与更新/step1.png

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: 填写开课院校，选择发布到本校课程网站或优学院网站。
steps.textEn: Enter the institution offering the course and choose whether to publish it to your school's course website or the uLearning website.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/课件发布与更新/step2.png

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: 设置课程是否在网站显示，核对发布范围后确认发布。
steps.textEn: Set whether the course is displayed on the website, verify the publishing scope, and then confirm the publication.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/课件发布与更新/step3.png

steps.label: Step 4
steps.text: 课件内容有修改时重新进入编辑页，完成修改并保存。
steps.textEn: If the courseware content is modified, re-enter the editing page, complete the changes, and save.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/课件发布与更新/step4.png

steps.label: Step 5
steps.text: 点击【更新】使新版本生效，并返回门户检查显示内容。
steps.textEn: Click Update to make the new version effective, then return to the portal to check the displayed content.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/课件发布与更新/step5.png

title: ULMS - 学生管理与分组
question: 如何管理学生并进行分组？
questionEn: How do I manage students and create groups?
aliases: 如何管理学生并进行分组？
How do I manage students and create groups?
path: 2026 教师用户手册 > ULMS > 学生管理与分组

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: 进入【成员】>【班级管理】，选择需要学生加入的班级。
steps.textEn: Go to Members > Class Management and select the class for students to join.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step1.png

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: 打开班级二维码并分享给学生，学生使用优学院 APP 扫码加入。
steps.textEn: Open the class QR code and share it with students; they scan it using the uLearning app to join.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step2.png

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: 也可以复制班级编码，让学生在平台或 APP 中输入编码加入。
steps.textEn: Alternatively, copy the class code and have students enter it on the platform or in the app to join.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step3.png

steps.label: Step 4
steps.text: 需要教师添加时点击【添加学生】，搜索并勾选学生后保存。
steps.textEn: If the teacher needs to add students, click Add Students, search for and select the students, then save.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step4.png

steps.label: Step 5
steps.text: 需要批量添加时下载导入模板，按模板填写学生信息。
steps.textEn: For bulk addition, download the import template and fill in student information according to the template.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step5.png

steps.label: Step 6
steps.text: 上传填写完成的模板，处理导入提示并核对学生名单。
steps.textEn: Upload the completed template, handle any import prompts, and verify the student list.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step6.png

steps.label: Step 7
steps.text: 进入班级的【分组管理】，点击创建新的学生分组。
steps.textEn: Go to the class's Group Management and click to create a new student group.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step7.png

steps.label: Step 8
steps.text: 填写组名并将学生分配到对应小组，检查是否有人遗漏。
steps.textEn: Enter the group name and assign students to the corresponding group, checking that no one is missed.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step8.png

steps.label: Step 9
steps.text: 保存分组，返回分组列表确认人数和成员关系正确。
steps.textEn: Save the group, then return to the group list to confirm the member count and relationships are correct.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/ULMS/学生管理与分组/step9.png

question: 如何让学生扫码进入 Uclass 课堂？
questionEn: How do I have students scan a QR code to enter a Uclass session?
aliases: 如何让学生扫码进入 Uclass 课堂？
How do I have students scan a QR code to enter a Uclass session?
path: 2026 教师用户手册 > Uclass > 学生扫码进入课堂

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: 先在 Uclass 课堂中点击【上课】，确保课堂已经开始；点击【课堂码】打开当前课堂二维码；让学生使用微信或优学院 APP 扫码，并在课堂成员列表核对进入状态。
steps.textEn: Open 上课 / 课堂码 and verify that the selected course, class, or exam is correct.

title: Uclass - 演示课件
question: 如何在 Uclass 课堂演示课件？
questionEn: How do I present courseware in Uclass?
aliases: 如何在 Uclass 课堂演示课件？
How do I present courseware in Uclass?
path: 2026 教师用户手册 > Uclass > 演示课件

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: 进入【进入课堂】模块。
steps.textEn: Go to the Enter Class module.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/Uclass/演示课件/step1.png

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: 点击【资源】，进入下一步设置。
steps.textEn: Click Resources to proceed to the next step.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/Uclass/演示课件/step2.png

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: 点击【从资源中打开】，进入下一步设置。
steps.textEn: Click Open from Resources to proceed to the next step.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/Uclass/演示课件/step3.png

title: Uclass - 发布课堂活动
question: 如何在 Uclass 发布课堂互动活动？
questionEn: How do I launch an interactive classroom activity in Uclass?
aliases: 如何在 Uclass 发布课堂互动活动？
How do I launch an interactive classroom activity in Uclass?
path: 2026 教师用户手册 > Uclass > 发布课堂活动

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: 进入【点名】模块。
steps.textEn: Go to the Roll Call module.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/Uclass/发布课堂活动/step1.png

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: 点击【创建点名】，进入下一步设置。
steps.textEn: Click Create Roll Call to proceed to the next step.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/Uclass/发布课堂活动/step2.png

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: 点击【设置活动规则】，进入下一步设置。
steps.textEn: Click Set Activity Rules to proceed to the next step.
steps.src: 截图教程/2026用户手册/Uclass/发布课堂活动/step3.png
